User Story Generator

Write proper agile user stories — 'As a… I want… so that…' — with a Given/When/Then acceptance criteria builder. Copy or download.

Your user story will appear here.

📖 How to use

  1. Fill in the role, goal, and benefit.
  2. Add acceptance criteria and points.
  3. Copy or download your user story.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What makes a user story?

The role, the goal, and the benefit — the classic 'As a [role], I want [goal], so that [benefit]' format.

How do acceptance criteria work?

Add as many Given/When/Then criteria as you need; each is numbered in the output.

Can I set story points?

Story points 1–13 (Fibonacci) plus a priority level.

How do I export it?

Copy the story or download it as a .txt file for your backlog tool.
